title: A short history of the organisation

_items.title: Founded in a single rented room
_items.body: Two colleagues set out to solve one stubborn problem, working evenings and weekends.

_items.title: First national contract
_items.body: A landmark agreement proved the model could scale beyond its home region.

_items.title: Expansion into three new markets
_items.body: New offices opened overseas, and the team grew past two hundred people.

_items.title: A recognised leader in the field
_items.body: Today the work reaches millions of users while keeping the original focus on quality.
